mapper.select: /* LeaveRefusalMapper.selectLaborRefusalTarget */ SELECT U.LEAVE_ID AS leaveId , U.START_DATE AS targetYmd FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U INNER JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G ON G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.GRANT_ID = U.GRANT_ID WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.START_DATE = #{targetYmd} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '00' AND U.PROMOTION_STAGE IN ('FIRST', 'SECOND') AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'STATUTORY_%' AND G.GRANT_TYPE <> 'STATUTORY_MONTHLY' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_HOLIDAY H WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND H.USE_YN = 'Y' AND H.HOLIDAY_YMD = STR_TO_DATE(#{targetYmd}, '%Y%m%d') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_HOLIDAY_RULE R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.HOLIDAY_MM = SUBSTR(#{targetYmd}, 5, 2) AND R.HOLIDAY_DD = SUBSTR(#{targetYmd}, 7, 2) ) LIMIT 1
